text:
[Council File 26-1579; CD 15]
Municipal Facilities Committee report relative to authorizing the General Services Department to negotiate and execute a license agreement with Southern California Marine Institute for docking space at Berth 260/261, Fish Harbor, Terminal Island, to dock the Bureau of Sanitation monitoring vessel.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Authorization for General Services to sign a license with Southern California Marine Institute for docking space at Fish Harbor on Terminal Island for a Bureau of Sanitation monitoring vessel.
